_about: The test hardware, by name. The real file lives outside the repo, at ~/Library/Application Support/outrigger/devices.json (or $OUTRIGGER_DEVICES); this example has made-up MACs and units. Tools ask for a device by label and refuse anything else (tools/devices.py). kind: esp32 (identified by MAC) or fm1 (by unit ID: the loader's, first 8 bytes of sector 0xE9000's sha256). A null unit means not read yet. host: the board's Wi-Fi address when it runs a DIAG_WEB build (firmware/waveshare_169/web.cpp names it by MAC).
